title: Does Chris Langan read this forum?
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.signature: Infinite Rider on the Big Dogma

posts.content:
He reminds me of Bruce a lot. He's active on X-Twitter too, mainly in his replies to others.https://x.com/RealChrisLangan/with_replies

I wish Langan visited here. With the surge in AI "thinking power," it would be great to train an RS2 model to take the next steps in filling in the gaps and questions toward RS3. AI could help in making terminology easier to understand. If we could scan Larson's books, for example, AI can read the pages now, and we could set up a model based on everything it compiles from the books, and have its concepts easier to digest on the output-side of its computing and whatever we can ask it. It's a great idea actually. Bruce gave me Larson's entire catalogue years back. It would just be a matter of scanning them. Does the foundation have digital copies already?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d8IZ0L5596s

Chris is a prime candidate for membership in this forum.
